title: 129. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock with Cooldown

examples.explanation: Buy on day 0, sell on day 1, cooldown, then buy on day 3 and sell on day 4.
With only one price, no transaction can be made, so the maximum profit is 0.

hints: Track the best value after each day in three states: holding, just sold, and resting.
A buy transition can only come from a resting state, not from the previous day's sold state.
